candidateContents.tickets: Release: master commit 7116ad8867639795e17714afca73844491d99c9e, version 0.0.29; includes settings ownership reorganization and binary editor host readiness protocol pull-model fix.
highlights: Settings ownership reorganization: translation default target language moved out of the AI provider section into General (new 翻译 group; data stays in the AI domain via ai:translation:setTargetLanguage, component features/ai/translation/TranslationDefaultSettings.tsx). Update settings now have a single entry point in the dedicated 更新 section (the duplicate block in 常规 is removed; SettingsService.updates remains the single source of truth). Global useSystemGit moved to the top of the Git section, and the global group stays visible and operable when no vault is open.

Settings search index aligned with actual UI placement: appearance.editorFontFamily/editorFontSize corrected to general/global, updates.* entries re-pointed to the new 'updates' sectionId (union type extended), two entries without any UI (git.syncStrategy / git.autoSyncIntervalSec) removed from the index, and 8 missing entries added (network host/port/bypass/AI & Git independent proxies, translation target language, binary-docs Git tracking).

Binary editor host readiness protocol switched to a pull model, fixing the intermittent stuck 等待加载文档… screen: the did-finish-load 1500ms forced-ack fallback used to push the queued initial 'load' via webContents.send into a host page whose event listener was not yet installed, permanently losing the command (cold start / slow disk / dev first compile could trigger it; xlsx and xmind equally affected). acknowledgeReady now returns the pending queue as the binary:host:ready invoke response (Result<{ commands }>); the host page applies it after subscribing, so the initial load can no longer be lost by construction. The fallback now only releases flush waiters and never marks the entry ready or dispatches pending commands.
Docs: user-guide settings table refreshed (adds the missing 网络 section, corrects section count and per-section contents).

Release hygiene: full gate suite re-run green at the candidate commit — lint (0 findings), prettier changed-file gate, typecheck (5/5 workspace projects), tests (1741 passed | 3 skipped across 183 files), verify-release-config 31/31, electron-vite build clean.
